milestone.title: Path + Milestones subtitle support — emit intent.outcome through path_engine and render a description line on the Milestones row

intent.outcome: The raul Path tab and the raul Milestones tab each render a ↳ preview second line under the title, sourced from milestone.intent.outcome (first non-empty line, truncated). Operators can read what each milestone is about without opening the detail panel.

problem.description: M206 (raul Path tab rework) shipped the 2-line preview renderer in crates/raul/src/tui/path_view.rs at line 226 — outcome_first_line reads item["milestone"]["intent"]["outcome"] and the path_view emits a ↳ <preview> line. But crates/mp/src/path_engine.rs, where every PathAction.milestone is constructed via json!(), never includes the intent field. Eight sites (lines 120, 419, 453, 684, 854, 931, 1007, 1052) emit only id / display / title / lifecycle / priority / depends_on — so the preview is always empty and the user sees a dangling ↳ glyph. Compounding this, the raul Milestones tab is single-line by design: MilestoneSummary (crates/raul/src/tui/app.rs:438) carries title only, parse_milestone_summaries (runner_helpers.rs:197) reads m["title"] and nothing else, and render_milestones_table (lane_lists.rs:551-558) builds rows with a single Cell::from(Span::styled(title, …)) per row. Both tabs share intent.outcome as the source — they should ship together so the data convention (field name, budget, truncation) lands once.

in_scope: WP1: patch every PathAction.milestone json!() site in crates/mp/src/path_engine.rs to include intent.outcome — the first non-empty line of the on-disk milestone.intent.outcome string. Update or add a single helper (e.g. milestone_intent_outcome_first_line(&MilestoneMeta)) and call it from all 8 sites so the implementation is not copy-pasted.

WP1: pin a golden test in crates/mp/tests/path_engine.rs that asserts the milestone JSON includes the intent.outcome key for every PathAction variant (step / grooming / coverage-gap / milestone-head / etc.).
WP2: extend MilestoneSummary (crates/raul/src/tui/app.rs) with intent_outcome: String. Default empty for milestones predating the field.
WP2: parse m["intent"]["outcome"] in parse_milestone_summaries (crates/raul/src/tui/runner_helpers.rs:197). Tolerate missing keys (older payloads) by defaulting to empty string.

WP2: switch render_milestones_table row height from 1 to 2 and emit a ↳ <preview> line under the title cell (same shape build_title_cell uses for the Backlog lane at lane_lists.rs:309). Truncate to the title column width with ` ` prefix.

WP2: refresh depends_on_depths indent math (lane_lists.rs:607) and the scrollbar accounting (view_state::compute_*_list_rects) so a 2-line row still divides the available data height correctly with hit-area sizes doubling.

WP2: pin golden tests in crates/raul/tests/ covering: (a) milestone row with preview renders both lines; (b) milestone row without preview renders one empty line so the row height contract is preserved; (c) depends_on indent math now correctly counts 2 lines per ancestor; (d) scrollbar thumb math holds.
out_of_scope: Adding a subtitle/subtitle field to the on-disk mp-model; the second line is derived from intent.outcome only.
Touching the dashboard lane, settings lane, autopilot lane, or any other lane renderers — only Path and Milestones change.
Migrating any historical milestone JSON predating the intent.outcome field (their preview will simply be empty).
Changing the truncation rules or content budget for the Preview line in path_view.rs — M206 / M207 budgets stay; we only plug the data.
Any CLI surface beyond what mp path / mp list milestones already emit.

acceptance_criteria.description: WP1: every PathAction.milestone JSON emitted by mp path contains an intent.outcome key whose value is the first non-empty line of the on-disk milestone.intent.outcome. Empty outcomes emit empty strings, not absent keys.
acceptance_criteria.verification: rg -n '"intent"' crates/mp/src/path_engine.rs (returns 8+ matches — every milestone: json! block now includes "intent": { "outcome": … }). A new test crates/mp/tests/path_engine_intent.rs asserts the key is present for each PathAction variant.

acceptance_criteria.description: WP1: the existing path tree renderer in raul now shows the ↳ <preview> line populated for milestones with non-empty outcomes. Milestones whose outcome is empty render only the ↳ prefix in dim color (no `(no description)` placeholder).
acceptance_criteria.verification: cargo nextest run -p raul --no-fail-fast -E 'test(/path_view_preview/)'. A new golden test in crates/raul/tests/tui_path_preview.rs feeds a hand-built JSON with intent.outcome = 'Solve the M225-R5 audit-trail gap' and asserts the rendered Line contains ↳ Solve the M225-R5 audit-trail gap.

acceptance_criteria.description: WP2: MilestoneSummary has a new intent_outcome: String field; parse_milestone_summaries reads it from the projection; render_milestones_table row height is 2 and the title cell carries both the title (line 1) and the ↳ preview line (line 2). Missing or empty outcome renders one empty line so the row-height contract holds.
acceptance_criteria.verification: cargo nextest run -p raul --no-fail-fast -E 'test(/tui_milestone_subtitle/)'. A new crate-level unit test exercises parse_milestone_summaries against a hand-built JSON and asserts intent_outcome is populated for milestones with intent.outcome; for those without it (legacy payloads), the field is empty string.

acceptance_criteria.description: WP2: depends_on_depths indent math + view_state scrollbar accounting remain correct under the new 2-line rows. A milestone with a depth-N parent still indents the correct number of visual spaces, and the hit-area scrollbar thumb height still maps to the right number of data rows.
acceptance_criteria.verification: cargo nextest run -p raul --no-fail-fast -E 'test(/(milestone_indent|milestone_scrollbar)/)'. The tests at crates/raul/tests/milestone_indent.rs and milestone_scrollbar.rs are extended for 2-line rows.
